name: Z-axis RLE Voxel Raycasting
definition: A raycasting traversal method for voxel volumes that compresses voxel data per X,Y column using run-length encoding (RLE) along the Z-axis to reduce memory bandwidth and accelerate ray intersection.
summary: Z-axis RLE Voxel Raycasting accelerates rendering by compressing voxel attributes per column along the Z-axis, reducing memory bandwidth at the cost of dynamic modification difficulty.
